cost_output_ceiling: variable primary energy plus fallback-trip spend only; whole-life ownership and lifecycle cost remain unknown
model_limitations: All config values are synthetic smoke-test assumptions, not measured vehicle, parts, repair, fuel-price, household, or transport-mode data.
Two fixed failure times are a deterministic stress replay and do not estimate failure probability, reliability, or population P50/P90.
Inventory delay credit is a simple sensitivity proxy and is not an inventory-control, supplier lead-time, or repair process model.
Fallback capacity and eligibility are hypothetical test inputs; no public transport, rideshare, walking, cycling, accessibility, timing, safety, or legal availability is verified.

The budget covers synthetic essential-mobility variable spend only; taxes, capital, financing, insurance, maintenance, tires, parts purchases, depreciation, downtime consequences, and whole-life ownership cost are excluded.
This model is not a vehicle dynamics model, roadworthiness or homologation test, safety case, or purchasing recommendation.
